title: Clinton said he didn't think they'd tell him about aliens
summary: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen tells of Clinton said he didn't think they'd tell him about aliens, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
And then later was President Clinton I
know was interviewed by somebody and
said do you believe that we have signs
of alien life and we've hiding or
there's a program or something and he
basically said, I don't think they tell
me even though I'm the president.

plain: A former CIA officer named Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, recalls an interview with former US President Bill Clinton. He says Clinton was asked whether the government had signs of alien life or a hidden programme, and answered, roughly, that he didn't think they would tell him even though he was the president. If true, it would suggest such secrets could be kept even from the person at the top.
